title: golden retriever barista drinking coffee flooded cozy cabin roastery graphic
description: A charming vintage-style graphic featuring a cheerful Golden Retriever wearing round eyeglasses, holding a steaming mug of hot coffee while standing in a flooded wooden cabin coffee shop. Beside the dog, a retro espresso machine and coffee beans rest on a wooden table, with steam swirling into the cozy room. Through the background window, a serene countryside scene with mountains and a small cottage is visible under a warm sunset. The circular framed design is embellished with coffee beans, botanical leaves, paw prints, and dog bones, making it a perfect artwork for dog lovers and coffee enthusiasts.
